title: Avocado toast with poached egg
steps: Bring a pot of water to a gentle simmer.
Crack each egg into a cup, slide it into the water and poach for 3–4 minutes.
Toast the bread and mash the avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Spread the toast with cottage cheese and avocado, top with the poached eggs and sprinkle with chilli flakes.
